title: Choose Reohob's new visual world
question: Warmer colour, lighter type, real photography, credible to homeowners and engineers alike. The roll assigned Lagos Tropical Modernism. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Lagos Tropical Modernism
options.lineage: 1960s–70s Nigerian modernist architecture: breeze-block screens, louvres, terrazzo, board-marked concrete, laterite and tropical planting
options.thesis: Reohob as part of the building: the language of Lagos's best sun-shading architecture, which has always been about managing the sun. Engineered, warm and local, not a generic solar template.
materials: breeze-block screen pattern as frame and divider
real photography of rooftops and installs
options.viewport: A full-width photograph of a sunlit Lagos rooftop array, framed on one edge by a breeze-block screen pattern. Headline set in a geometric modernist sans at medium weight (no black), with Get a Quote in marigold and WhatsApp beside it. A small live 'today's sun over Lagos' strip sits on the concrete panel below.
options.risk: Pattern overuse would turn architecture into wallpaper; the screen motif must stay a frame, never a background.

raised.raise: Each page leads with one decisive photograph, never a collage.
Solid deep-green fill is reserved for the one conversion band per page.
Content sits on bands and rules, not boxed cards.
The hero follows Lagos time: a daylight photo by day, a dusk photo after sunset with the battery message.
Every figure keeps its trend: the live sun strip stays, small and honest.
Marigold marks the active state and the main action only.

options.label: Golden Hour Lagos
options.thesis: Sunlit, optimistic and photo-first: big golden-hour images of homes and installs, soft warm neutrals and a deep forest green, friendly medium-weight type.
options.viewport: A full-bleed golden-hour photo of a home with panels, headline and two buttons over a soft gradient scrim at the lower left.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three: it sits close to what most solar companies ship, so Reohob must win on photography and copy, not on look.

options.label: Sleeping City Fold
options.case: Fuses poorly: night and dream read as cold and abstract, the opposite of the brief.

options.label: Chromatophore Skin
options.case: Fuses poorly: homeowners and engineers don't read biology as power.
options.kept: One signal colour carries the active state.

options.label: Manga Screentone Page
options.case: Fuses poorly: monochrome newsprint contradicts 'warmer colours'.
options.kept: Solid fill reserved for the decisive beat.

options.label: Polish Film Poster
options.case: Fuses poorly: no grid or typeface undermines specs, prices and forms.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark and nostalgic, not warm or credible.
options.kept: Nothing boxed that doesn't need a box.

options.label: Night-Flight Six-Pack
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark and technical, the feel you asked to move away from.
options.kept: Figures show trend as well as value.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What solar installers ship, executed impeccably: clean white pages, a big rooftop photo hero, a single green brand colour, clear service sections.
canonCard.viewport: A rooftop solar photo hero with headline and two buttons, then a strip of service cards.
